01837 Dannah {dan-naw'}

字源不詳; 專有名詞 地名

AV - Dannah 1; 1

大拿 = "你 (神) 已審判" 或是 "審判"
1) 在猶大丘陵區域的小鎮, 可能在希伯崙的南邊或西南邊 (#書15:49|)

of uncertain derivation;; n pr loc

Dannah = "thou hast judged" or "judgement"
1) a town in the hill country of Judah, probably south or southwest
   of Hebron
